# BTC Live patch pull request

## Issue

Link the bug report, Chrome Web Store review feedback, or other validated maintenance issue.

## Scope

- [ ] This change fixes existing v1.0.x behavior.
- [ ] No new user-facing feature is introduced.
- [ ] No unrelated refactor is included.
- [ ] Existing public behavior and data formats remain compatible unless the documented defect requires otherwise.

## Reproduction

Describe the original failure and the smallest reliable reproduction.

## Fix

Describe the minimal change and why it addresses the root cause.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes.
- [ ] Relevant regression coverage was added or existing coverage is sufficient.
- [ ] Chromium build succeeds.
- [ ] Firefox build succeeds.
- [ ] No unnecessary permissions were added.
- [ ] No remote code, analytics, tracking, ads, or backend dependency was introduced.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md is updated if this PR will ship in a patch release.

## Versioning

Expected release impact:

- [ ] No release yet
- [ ] PATCH release only (1.0.x)
